note: These are the seat's working questions, written for this pack from the coaching-question concepts in the source notes. They are functional prompts, not quotations, and are never presented as the author's words.

items.question: Why does this business exist, beyond the money it makes?
items.purpose: Force the owned question into the open before options are scored.

items.question: Why are your customers your customers, and why are your employees your employees?
items.purpose: Surface whether anyone in the room actually knows the cause of the loyalty the plan depends on.

items.question: If this product disappeared tomorrow, what cause would still remain?
items.purpose: Separate the WHY from the current WHAT.

items.question: Which action in this plan would we be embarrassed to describe next to our stated purpose?
What in this plan still works at full price, with no promotion running?
When did we last turn something down because it was not us, and what did it cost?
items.purpose: Test whether the WHY has ever actually filtered a decision.

items.question: Tell me about a specific moment this work made you proud. What exactly happened, and how did it feel?
items.purpose: Begin story mining when the WHY is unknown, in the discovery method's own form.

items.question: What did that moment let other people do or become?
items.purpose: Draw out contribution and impact, the two halves of a usable WHY statement.

items.question: Which of our stated principles would this option require us to break in practice, not on paper?
items.purpose: Run the second step of the filter, the HOW test, against real behavior.

items.question: What is the most tempting distraction in front of us right now: profitable, available, and not us?
items.purpose: Produce the one concrete distraction the seat is required to name in its output.
